audit_findings.title: Post-year-end Bindplane acquisition breaks the valuation perimeter
audit_findings.magnitude: $100.2 million cash consideration; $0.33 per diluted share; 3.1%-4.1% of stated scenario equity values
audit_findings.mechanism: The June 2026 cash bridge reflects the acquisition payment, while anchor OE predates Bindplane and therefore excludes its operating contribution.
audit_findings.evidence: On April 14, 2026, the Company acquired all of the outstanding equity of observIQ, Inc. d/b/a Bindplane, a provider of an open-standards-based telemetry pipeline that helps organizations capture and manage data at scale, for total cash consideration of $ 100.2 million.
audit_findings.explanation: The perimeter mismatch is demonstrated, not merely possible. Restoring the entire $100.2 million consideration would add about $0.33 per share, raising stated values to approximately $8.34-$10.79 before any other changes; that remains far below the $51.90 market price. The filed June-quarter Bindplane revenue and net income were also not material, so the available record does not indicate an omitted operating contribution capable of reversing the conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Rerun on a consistent perimeter using either pro forma Bindplane OE and the June bridge or pre-acquisition cash and liabilities; document Bindplane revenue, cash operating costs, working capital, taxes, and acquired liabilities.

audit_findings.title: Deferred sales commissions may be understated as a recurring cash cost
audit_findings.magnitude: $31.057 million FY2026 operating-cash-flow reduction, equal to 24.6% of the $126.4 million anchor OE
audit_findings.mechanism: If commission amortization was charged in earnings but current deferred-contract-cost investment was not deducted, anchor OE and every growth scenario are overstated.
audit_findings.evidence: These contract costs for new and renewal contracts are deferred and then amortized on a straight-line basis over a period of benefit which the Company has estimated to be three years .
audit_findings.explanation: This is an unresolved possibility rather than a demonstrated error because the detailed OE calculation was not supplied. The filed cash-flow adjustment is nevertheless large relative to anchor OE: omission could reduce the anchor by $31.057 million to approximately $95.343 million before related tax effects, reasonably capable of materially changing the valuation outputs.
audit_findings.action: Trace FY2026 OE line by line and reconcile the $167.234 million additions, $131.820 million amortization, and $31.057 million cash-flow adjustment exactly once; then rerun all scenarios if the cash investment was omitted.

audit_findings.title: The finite IP-transfer tax schedule is not visible in the forecast
audit_findings.mechanism: The finite U.S. taxation through 2044 and Swiss tax deductions through 2035 affect after-tax OE during the explicit forecast and the normalized tax burden entering terminal value.
audit_findings.evidence: The transaction is taxable in the U.S. through 2044.
audit_findings.explanation: The filing demonstrates unusual, time-limited tax economics, but it does not establish that the valuation extrapolated FY2026 taxes incorrectly or provide the annual cash-tax amounts needed to measure the effect. The direction is mixed because FY2026 may contain both U.S. IP-transfer taxation and Swiss deductions. With terminal value representing 46.3%-51.5% of operating value, an incorrect normalized tax burden could matter, but materiality cannot be established from the record.
audit_findings.action: Construct a yearly cash-tax schedule through 2044 covering U.S. IP-transfer taxation, Swiss deductions through 2035, deferred-tax reversals, GILTI, foreign tax credits, branch income, royalties, and withholding taxes; normalize taxes after expiry and rerun the valuation.

audit_findings.title: Non-current marketable securities may be missing from the cash bridge
audit_findings.magnitude: $43.701 million of unrestricted long-term marketable securities; $0.14 per diluted share; 1.4%-1.8% of stated scenario equity values
audit_findings.mechanism: Portfolio interest income is purged from OE, but unrestricted non-current securities are omitted from the equity bridge, understating non-operating asset value.
audit_findings.evidence: As of March 31, 2026, we had $1,097.2 million of cash and cash equivalents, $126.8 million of marketable securities (primarily consisting of U.S. Treasury securities, corporate debt securities, U.S. agency securities, and commercial paper that have maturities between one and 30 months) and $399.0 million available under our Credit Facility.
audit_findings.explanation: The omission is demonstrated: the $1,108.864 million bridge equals June cash of $1,057.780 million plus short-term securities of $51.084 million. Filed long-term securities were $47.079 million, of which $3.378 million were restricted mutual funds, leaving $43.701 million unrestricted. Adding that amount changes value by only about $0.14 per share and the 30%-MOS buy-below level by about $0.10, leaving the valuation conclusion unchanged versus the $51.90 price.
audit_findings.action: Add the $43.701 million unrestricted long-term securities to the bridge, confirm none are acquisition-committed or otherwise restricted, and rerun the per-share and buy-below arithmetic.
